English: Open Firepit
A basic circle of stones and earth, the heart of any fledgling camp. Provides warmth and a place for communal gathering, but little protection or comfort.
Timber Hearth
A hastily constructed wooden shelter around the firepit, offering improved warmth and a focal point for the clan to gather and share resources.
Stone Chimney Hut
A sturdier hut built with gathered stone and a proper chimney, providing reliable heat and shelter for a growing population.
Gathering Room
A central timbered hall with benches and a long hearth, where the clan assembles for feasts, councils, and winter nights.
Warmed Yurt
A large, insulated yurt with a central stone hearth, combining mobility with superior comfort and enabling the clan to thrive even in harsh seasons.
Feasting Hall
A broad, timbered hall with a grand hearth, hosting feasts and councils for the entire clan. A center for unity and grandeur, its warmth draws all together.
Story Room
A special chamber set aside within the hall, adorned with tapestries and hearths, where legends are told and traditions passed along, strengthening clan unity and morale.
Communal Fireplace
A mighty stone hearth at the heart of the settlement, always burning, symbolizing unity and offering warmth, food, and morale to all.
Great Hearth Hall
A monumental timber and stone hall, its grand hearth blazing year-round, where the clans greatest feasts, decisions, and celebrations are held.
Royal Hearth House
The ultimate seat of power and tradition: a magnificent stone and timber palace with a colossal central hearth, symbolizing the unity, prosperity, and strength of the Central Germanic clan.
